Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: ACPCE Agence Congolaise pour la Création des Entreprises has online portal for business registration formalities, statistics, repertoire.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Verified via ACPCE's own sites: monentreprise.acpce.cg offers a fully dematerialised, 100% digital single-window business registration process (online form, payment and electronic document delivery) covering all departments/communes, backed by six regional interdepartmental offices and a 2018 decree mandating electronic signatures across all partner agencies (2023-2025 evidence). This is stronger than 'partially deployed'; revised to 5 (fully deployed nationwide).

Definition: What proportion of the population does the register cover?
Comments: Birth registration completeness low based on regional trends and lack of digital data; World Bank indicator exists but no specific number found; proxy <50%.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original comment assumed <50% without citing a figure, but World Bank/UNICEF data (WDI SP.REG.BRTH.ZS, via CEIC) record national birth registration completeness of 95.9% in 2015 (98.7% urban, 91.4% rural), corroborated by UNICEF's 2022 Africa Birth Registration brochure citing MICS 2014-15 (94-96%) and an APAI-CRVS/UNECA report noting Congo above 90%. Revised to 5 (>89%); flagged for human review since the newest reliable household survey is 2014-15/2015, over a decade old, with no more recent survey identified.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more social protection registers?
Comments: Social Registry Lisungi contains >60,000 households for social protection access.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The cited 2019 figure (>60,000 households) is superseded: a 2024 World Bank project completion report records 852,149-893,000 households (roughly two-thirds of Congo's population) registered in the digital Registre Social Unique (RSU) — the highest RSU coverage in Sub-Saharan Africa — and notes the government institutionalised the Lisungi delivery systems into a National Safety Net Program (Programme national de filets sociaux) by decree in 2023. Revised to 5 (fully deployed nationwide).

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more tax registers?
Comments: Portail fiscal officiel impots.gouv.cg for taxpayer services online.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed via Ministry of Finance sources: the DGID taxpayer portal (impots.gouv.cg/portail-client-web, télé-déclarant space) plus E-TAX (online tax file access) and E-PAY-CONGO (online duty/tax payment via bank and mobile money) exist, and the digital fiscal stamp (DFA, launched 2021) was initially piloted in only 5 sites in Brazzaville, indicating partial rather than nationwide rollout. Score of 4 (partially deployed) confirmed; original bare domain (impots.gouv.cg) did not resolve directly but the live portal was found at the /portail-client-web/ path.
